async def act(page):
    # Try to find and click the 'Members' link in the project navigation
    try:
        members_link = page.get_by_role('complementary', name='Project navigation').get_by_role('link', name='Members')
        await members_link.click()
    except Exception:
        # If not found, navigate directly to the members page using the common URL pattern
        await page.goto('/byteblaze/dotfiles/-/project_members')
    # Wait for the page to load after navigation
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
